description: Be sure to get this special set! With LIMITED BOX Ver.β you can be among the first to test it out. FEATURED CARDS VIEW CARDS The LIMITED BOX Ver.β is all you need to start playing the game right away. This product contains everything you need to play and start building decks, including Booster Packs, a Card Set and Dice Damage Counters. Use the included Booster Packs and Card Set to build a deck. Be among the first to enjoy the GUNDAM CARD GAME! There are 3 ways to obtain the LIMITED BOX Ver.β.
